name: Black Disciples
description: The Black Disciples (BDs) are an African-American street gang founded in 1966 by David Barksdale on Chicago's South Side, growing out of the earlier Devil's Disciples. In 1969, Barksdale merged with Larry Hoover's Supreme Gangsters to form the Black Gangster Disciple Nation (BGDN); after Barksdale died of kidney failure in 1974, the alliance fractured and the BDs formally split from the Gangster Disciples in the early 1980s, joining the Folk Nation. War with the GDs erupted in 1991 and drew international attention in 1994 when 11-year-old member Robert 'Yummy' Sandifer killed a bystander and was subsequently executed by fellow BDs. The gang operates across Chicago and at least nine other states, with roughly 300 sets in the Chicagoland area as of the mid-2000s.
